kal tak

items.context: Can you confirm if you want cash on delivery option only
items.text: thik hai

items.context: Can you please wait while I check your payment status
items.text: thoda ruk jao

items.context: Do you have the cash ready for delivery
items.text: paise ready hai
mere paas cash the lekin woh jaga nahi thi dekha
mai payment karne gaya tha par delivery wale chale gaye
Umm mera order cancel ho gaya kya payment ki wajah se
cod se payment karne par transaction fail ho rahi hai
Mujhe lagta hai payment collect nahi hui delivery par
Woh kal delivery thi main present nahi tha payment ke liye
Haan ji cash ready tha lekin delivery person bola nahi lega paise

items.context: Are you facing any issue with payment on delivery
items.text: Haan mujhe payment accept karna tha par nahi ho pa raha

items.context: Did the delivery person provide you any receipt after payment
items.text: Paise le liye lekin receipt nahi di delivery ne

items.context: Can you confirm if the delivery person reached your address
items.text: Woh mera address thoda galat ho gaya nahi mile the

items.context: Was the payment supposed to be cash on delivery or prepaid
items.text: Woh uncle ko payment deni thi lekin unhone online kiya

items.context: What did the delivery person say about payment issue
items.text: Umm delivery boy bola payments process me hai thoda wait karo
Maine cash ready rakha tha jab delivery aya tabhi payment accept nahi hua
Yeh payment issue ho raha hai baar baar ki payment collect nahi kar pa rahe hain
Order cancel nahi karna tha par payment failure ki wajah se woh ho gaya

items.context: Can you check if payment has been deducted from your account for your recent order
items.text: Mere account mein payment dikha nahi raha hai delivery ne paise liye the kya

items.context: When exactly was your delivery scheduled before cancellation due to payment issue
items.text: Delivery scheduled thi last Wednesday nahi Tuesday woh confusion tha payment nahi hua

items.context: Did the delivery person attempt to collect cash on delivery when they reached your location
items.text: Paise ready the mere ghar par jab delivery hua tha lekin phir bhi payment reject ho gaya

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: cod_payment - has a problem with cash on delivery or payment at the door
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
